title.narrative: Accelerating SDGs through Localization in Kenya

description.narrative: The Constitution of Kenya 2010 and the Public Finance Management Act 2012 embed public participation (PP) in Kenya’s development process. Various platforms for public participation exist but citizen voices are missing or underdeveloped, due to inadequate resources, lack of political will and retrogressive cultural attitudes. This has slowed implementation of SDGs at the county level. 17 counties 17 counties (Kakamega, Vihiga, Elgeyo Marakwet, Bungoma, Kajiado, Narok, Taita Taveta, Homa Bay, West Pokot, Mombasa, Nyeri, Embu, Makueni, Baringo, Kilifi, Busia and Wajir) have undertaken VLR on SDGs 4, 5, 14, 15 and 17. This created an enabling institutional environment for implementation of SDGs at the county level. However, acceleration of SDGs is still low at the subnational level owing to: (i) weak link between county plans and execution of budgets; (ii) limited use of disaggregated data to inform planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring processes; (iii) inefficient use of county budgets to accelerate SDGs at subcounty levels; (iv) low participation of citizens in localization of SDGs; and (v) weak oversight by county assemblies. For accelerated delivery of SDGs, the intervention will, on the supply side, support: (i) Finalization and implementation of public participation policies; (ii) Oversight through county assemblies; (iii) Targeting of plans and budgets to deliver for people left most behind; (iv) Upscaling pathways for successful interventions through intergovernmental institutions; and (v) Undertaking VLR that feeds into the VNR. On the demand side: (i) Budget information, transparency, and advocacy; (ii) Use technology to track and report execution of county projects; (iii) Feedback mechanism between citizens and duty bearers; and (iv) A national conference on SDGs progress in Kenya. The initiative contributes to Outcome 1.1 and Output 1.1.2 of the Kenya UNSDCF 2022 – 26.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
